column1: # PEANUTS: the games players see in the README's Supported games table (README.md and peanuts/docs/README.github.md), in the table's order.
# peanuts/scripts/games_catalog.py reads it with peanuts/release-titles.txt (which games ship) and each dm/games/<title ID>/game.tsv (the builds
# Android plays) and writes the two tables and peanuts/games.json; on main, .github/workflows/catalog.yml does that.
#   name       the name players know (the profile's may be in capitals)
#   update     the Game update cell, only for a game whose profile has no display version ("?"); empty: the profile's versions
#   companion  yes or no: whether eden-duo-companions has a release for it. games_catalog.py --refresh sets it from those releases, and adds
#              a row (the profile's name, at the end) for a game that ships without one
#   since      optional: the release a game first ships in ("0.1.6"); while peanuts/VERSION is older, the README counts it as coming
#              in that release and marks its row. Empty: it shipped in an earlier release
